post_title: The witness, in their own words
post: I saw everything. It was {topic.generic}. I'd know that look anywhere.
A noise at 21:13. Then a guilty silence. Not saying who. It was {topic.generic}.
Can't believe I'm a witness in the {topic.bare} case. Wore my best jumper.
Me at 21:13: a quiet night in. Me at 21:14: witness to the crime of the century.
To whoever was {crime}: I know it was you. Everyone knows.
Saw {seed.one} walk past looking guilty. Not saying anything. Just saying.
Witness, day 3. Still asked about {crime}. I'd like to go home.
quiz_question: Where was the defendant on the night of the 14th?
Where was the defendant at the time of the crime?
Where was the defendant when the lights went out?
Where did the witness last see the defendant?
Where was the defendant during the quiet bit?
quiz_option: On a bus to the seaside
quiz_answer: At the scene of the crime
quiz_explanation: A witness saw the whole thing.
The security camera leaves no doubt.
The trail of evidence leads straight there.
Exhibit D, which nobody has seen yet.
The defendant left a note. It was signed.
